name: Contorted Epitome

bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: This Threat and its riders may use Ruin Actions. They have 3 personal Ruin between them.

bonuses.name: Heralds of Slaanesh
bonuses.text: If any Daemonette is within Short Range of the Contorted Epitome, they may re-roll any 1s on their attack rolls.

bonuses.name: Mount
bonuses.text: A Contorted Epitome may be ridden by 2 Tormentbringers. They take their Turns together, using the Contorted Epitome's movement, and each have their own Action. Riders and mount may be targeted separately.

abilities.name: Disquieting Creature & Quicksilver Swiftness
abilities.text: Anyone that can see or hear a Contorted Epitome or its riders must make a DN 4 Fear Test. The Tormentbringers then act first in the Initiative order as though they had Seized the Initiative.

abilities.name: Soulstain
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin. The Contorted Epitome attempts to activate a psychic power from the Soulstain Discipline or Deny the Witch (Wrath & Glory, p. 267).

note: Personal Ruin 3 is shared between the mount and its two Tormentbringer riders (printed 'between them'). Printed beside Tranceweaver; the text introducing it is the Contorted Epitome's.
determination: Daemonic Determination: Spend 1 Ruin to roll 5d6 (Daemonettes) or 6d6 (Contorted Epitome). Daemons can roll Determination against Mortal Wounds. Any Wounds negated by Determination are ignored instead of being converted to Shock.
